sharpenedFix: Leave b.css:877 alone and cap no width: a static 32ch forces a needless second line from 1024 up, where all 70 characters fit on one. In render-b.js's .b-linkRow (and render-c.js's), split the URL at its midpoint with a <wbr> between the halves. Verified: 35/35 at 390 and 768, one line at 1024/1279/1280/1440, no breakpoint arithmetic. Then extend interaction-check.mjs's widow assertion to long unbreakable data strings at all four widths, not to every text node, where short prose last lines would false-fail.
